summary: ClearSign Technologies Corp filed a prospectus supplement (424B5) to recommence an at-the-market (ATM) offering of up to $6,875,000 of common stock under an existing sales agreement with H.C. Wainwright. No shares were previously sold under the prior supplement. The offering will be made through Wainwright as sales agent, with a 3.0% commission, at market prices. The filing is a routine capital-raising continuous offering, not a special situation. No special-situation characteristics apply.
